description: The bar chart illustrates the performance comparison of two models, the NESAC ft model and the SESHA ft model, across five different optimisations applied: Normalised, Add Spacing, Remove Spacing, Americanisms, and Dates. The horizontal axis represents the performance metric, with values ranging from 0.000 to 0.004, while the vertical axis lists the optimisations. Each optimisation has two bars, one orange for the NESAC ft model and one green for the SESHA ft model. The values for each bar are explicitly labeled at the end of the bar. For the Normalised optimisation, the NESAC ft model has a value of 0.00334 and the SESHA ft model has a value of 0.00323. For Add Spacing, the NESAC ft model has a value of 0.00319 and the SESHA ft model has a value of 0.00344. For Remove Spacing, the NESAC ft model has a value of 0.00311 and the SESHA ft model has a value of 0.00306. For Americanisms, the NESAC ft model has a value of 0.00299 and the SESHA ft model has a value of 0.00302. For Dates, the NESAC ft model has a value of 0.00257 and the SESHA ft model has a value of 0.00228. The legend at the bottom of the chart identifies the orange bars as the NESAC ft model and the green bars as the SESHA ft model.
